name: value-utilities/space-divide
description: Sibling-pair utilities — `space-x-*`, `space-y-*`, `divide-x-*`, `divide-y-*`, `divide-<color>`, `divide-<style>`. Each emits on `<class> > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden])` rather than `<class>`. Mirrors `corePlugins.js` `space` and `divideWidth`/`divideColor`/`divideStyle` plugins. The reverse statics (`space-x-reverse` etc.) flip the `--tw-*-reverse` custom property so the sibling pair direction inverts. Tailwind special-cases `0` -> `0px` so the `calc()` arithmetic works.
